extraction.Name: William Z. Emery
extraction.Buyer: The Jackson Brothers purchased the land; allottee was supposed to get $3,000.00 but did not get all; $130.00 taxes paid and $190.00 was held out by a lawyer
extraction.Occupation/Income: working in the mines at Leadville, Colorado
extraction.NOTES: Did sign a receipt for the patent; patent was handed to him at Winner, South Dakota; did make application for patent; states he did not receive the value of the land, was sick at the time and had to take what was offered, does not think he received a square deal, that they took advantage of the condition he was in; Never been mortgaged by him; wife and 1 boy dependent on him; in poor health — stomach trouble; document notarized July 13, 1929, State of Colorado, County of Lake; received stamp dated SEP 30 1929
extraction.Literate/Illiterate: Illiterate — signed with an X mark
